reason: The hypothesis makes multiple specific claims about phase stability, diffusion kinetics, precipitation behavior, and oxidation mechanisms in Mg-containing HEAs, but cites no prior evidence whatsoever to support any of these premises.
premises: Mg-containing lightweight HEAs can be retained in a metastable single-phase solid solution
Isothermal ageing above a critical temperature (~600°C) triggers Mg diffusion and phase separation
Mg-rich intermetallic precipitates nucleate and grow during this ageing
These intermetallics act as preferential sites for heterogeneous oxide nucleation in oxidizing atmospheres
This leads to a discontinuous, defective oxide scale and loss of oxidation/corrosion resistance
